verdict.rationale: Qodo ships its own assistant inside pull requests: users can chat with Qodo, use the Fix with Chat Agent to remediate issues mid-conversation, or have Qodo apply a fix directly. Community reports of the Qodo Command CLI agent, including its SWE-bench result and rwx permission toggles, corroborate a working first-party agent. missing for 10: documented range of delegable tasks beyond review-finding fixes and PR Q&A, in-depth docs on the chat agent's capabilities and limits, independent hands-on corroboration of the in-PR chat/fix agent specifically.
